summary: Moved myiotsan device onboarding (the MQTT enrollment window, the network scan, and the candidate/adopt flow) from a standalone admin-only "Discovery" entry under the System nav group to an admin-only "Discover" sub-tab under the Devices page, alongside a new "Inventory" sub-tab (the device list plus manual "Add device") -- a frontend-only navigation change, no API or backend behavior moved. New apps/myiotsan/views/react-webpack/src/views/components/deviceshome.js exports DevicesHome, a controlled two-tab wrapper (built on the shared @shared/Tabs) that renders the existing, unchanged DevicesPage under Inventory and the existing, unchanged DiscoveryPage under Discover; App.js now renders DevicesHome for the devices tab (lifting a devicesSub state so the first-run wizard's "go set up a device" action can land directly on Discover), and the standalone discovery nav entry/route/import were removed from layout.js and App.js. Rationale: onboarding a device is something an operator looks for under "Devices", not as a separate System-level page.
compatibility: Purely a UI reorganisation for every existing myiotsan install -- no entity, API route, or RBAC rule changed. Every /api/discovery/* route remains admin-only, enforced server-side exactly as before; hiding the Discover sub-tab from non-admin sessions in the DevicesHome component is UX on top of that pre-existing enforcement, not a new security boundary. No migration, no restart-required setting, no config key. New i18n keys devices.tabInventory/devices.tabDiscover were added to all four locales (en/ms/zh/ar).
